purpose: Hard-gap-only acquisition wave. Every entry targets one of the remaining shortages: shot-to-action-to-recovery, rights-clear cross-machine/multimould data, hot-runner actual state, cooling cleaning/recovery, material-lot/batch linkage, or raw multimaterial/2K evidence. Generic single-machine traces are excluded.

sources.name: Industrial zero-defect main + transfer injection-moulding datasets
sources.dataAvailability: Data will be available upon request.
sources.value: High-value real industrial transfer family with two labeled cycle datasets and severe real class imbalance; directly advances cross-machine/cross-context quality validation.

sources.name: Cycle-to-cycle visual + part-weight quality control with disturbance recovery
sources.verifiedOutcome: Experimental controllers recovered target quality from suboptimal initial conditions within approximately 10-15 shots; the norm-optimal controller rejected a significant material-viscosity disturbance without operator intervention.
sources.rights: SSRN posting is all-rights-reserved; underlying experimental data release not identified.
sources.value: One of the closest public studies to the missing fault/disturbance -> action -> verified recovery pattern, with physical visual quality rather than weight alone.

sources.name: State-aware hot/cold-runner energy and material-variation experiment
reportedTooling: pressure transducers on all valve gates
reportedMaterials: three PP conditions including 100% recycled PP and modified recycled PP
sources.reportedHotRunnerController: Mold-Master MT-12-12 multi-zone temperature control unit
sources.protocol: Up to 10 repeated cycles per nominal DOE setting; cycle counters/timing used to synchronize energy measurements.
sources.value: Adds rare measured hot-runner-controller energy plus gate pressure, runner type and recycled-material variation in the same experimental family. Raw row-level source data are not explicitly released in the article record.

sources.name: Actionable world-model injection-moulding action/pressure transition datasets
sources.value: Direct action -> observed pressure-state transition data; useful for validating whether MouldMaster recommended adjustments produce the expected signal direction.
sources.access: Paper is publicly accessible through ZHAW; raw datasets were not located in the repository record during this review.

sources.name: Gravalos 14-month injection-moulding production records controlled-data route
sources.verifiedOutcome: Published OEE rose from 53.93% in January 2025 to 95.80% in December 2025 before later normalisation; the full industrial records are confidential.
sources.overlap: Links existing production case PROD-004; do not count this as a new independent experiment merely because a controlled repository route exists.
sources.value: Potential controlled-access route to real longitudinal failures, maintenance and production recovery rather than only aggregate case metrics.

sources.name: Eight-circuit mould cooling descaling before/after flow case
sources.reportedProtocol: Eight mould cooling circuits measured before and after 30 minutes of circulated descaling treatment.
sources.value: Rare explicit fouling/cleaning -> measured hydraulic recovery example. Vendor case rather than peer-reviewed dataset, so evidentiary grade must remain lower.

sources.name: Mould cooling-pipe cleaning cycle-time recovery case
sources.reportedProtocol: Six-hour mould water-tube cleaning with integrated flow-rate monitoring.
sources.verifiedOutcome: Cooling time reduced from 17 s to 13 s, reported as a 23% improvement.
sources.value: Independent before/after recovery evidence connecting cooling-circuit cleaning to cycle productivity; technical presentation rather than raw longitudinal dataset.

sources.name: Hydraulic-to-electric machine process transfer with iterative learning control
sources.verifiedOutcome: Transfer from a hydraulic to an electric injection-moulding machine converged within a few cycles and reproduced reference trajectories while producing high-quality parts.
sources.value: Direct machine-change -> automated action -> recovered process/quality evidence, complementing predictive cross-machine studies.
sources.access: Article/preprint accessible; reusable experimental raw dataset not located.

sources.name: 2026 cross-machine quality prediction transfer-learning experiment
sources.reportedResult: High target-machine classification performance was reported using only 60% of the target machine data.
sources.value: Independent 2026 cross-machine physical-quality validation family; useful acquisition target for rights-clear multi-machine raw data.

sources.name: Overmoulding process monitoring with tool-mounted infrared temperature and pressure sensors
sources.dataAvailability: Datasets generated/analyzed are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
sources.value: Directly addresses raw 2K/overmould process-state sensing rather than final mechanical tests only.

sources.name: PC/AA6061 injection-overmould joint processing, fatigue and hygrothermal dataset target
sources.articleAccess: Open-access article under a Creative Commons licence
sources.reportedOutcome: Optimised joints reached 7.2 +/- 0.5 MPa lap-shear strength and retained useful strength after hygrothermal aging; fatigue testing extended to 10^6 cycles.
sources.dataAvailability: Data will be made available on request.
sources.value: Adds longitudinal/lifecycle physical outcome to multimaterial overmoulding and is independently requestable.

sources.name: ABS/PC injection-overmould process-to-shrinkage/warpage/tensile study
sources.supportingInformation: Publisher exposes a supplementary Data S1 document; underlying numeric data are also available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request.
sources.value: Useful 2-material process -> dimensional/mechanical outcome family with a publisher-hosted supplementary route.

sources.name: Six consecutive PCR-HDPE material batches linked to injection-process and part-quality variation
sources.value: One of the strongest public descriptions of real batch identity -> material characterization -> injection-process actuals -> physical part outcomes, directly addressing the material-lot linkage gap.

sources.name: Recyclate batch-change weight-control recovery field experiment
sources.verifiedOutcome: After batch change caused shot weight to fall into defective production, activating iQ weight control raised shot weights back into the reference material range and restored a cavity-pressure trajectory close to the reference.
sources.value: Direct material-batch disturbance -> automated process action -> measured recovery case. Manufacturer technical publication, so keep below independent peer-reviewed/raw-data evidence.
